# PoC 2: DPIR on a fixed point-to-point Terragraph ring (generated by poc2.py)

No MARL, no event, no PtMP. Four 2-sector Siklu N367 nodes (the two GTS003 Spider boxes) form a ring of four fixed DN-DN point-to-point links. Two cabled co-channel couplings make the two spans interfere while both carry traffic; DPIR routes one flow the long way round and the interference disappears.

**Result at the nominal setting (INR 18 dB):** hop-count 970 Mb/s, Terragraph MCS-based Open/R 1420 Mb/s (average, 15 route changes in 120 s), DPIR 2500 Mb/s (+158 % over hop-count).

## Sites, sectors and Spider-box modules

| Site | Box (slot) | Node | Polarity | Sector -> peer (module, link) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| W1 | GTS003 #1 (U16) | a | even | E -> E1 (M1, LN); S -> W2 (M2, LW) |
| E2 | GTS003 #1 (U16) | b | even | N -> E1 (M4, LE); W -> W2 (M3, LS) |
| E1 | GTS003 #2 (U13) | a | odd | S -> E2 (M2, LE); W -> W1 (M1, LN) |
| W2 | GTS003 #2 (U13) | b | odd | E -> E2 (M3, LS); N -> W1 (M4, LW) |

| KW | W1.E (even) - W2.E (odd) | W1->E1 hits E2->W2 (subframe A); W2->E2 hits E1->W1 (subframe B) | INR 18 dB (SIR 7 dB) | ATT-5 |
| KE | E1.W (odd) - E2.W (even) | E2->W2 hits W1->E1 (subframe A); E1->W1 hits W2->E2 (subframe B) | INR 18 dB (SIR 7 dB) | ATT-6 |

## Robustness

- Time-share bound (ideal per-slot adaptation, optimistic for the baselines): hop-count 970, DPIR 2500 Mb/s.
- Smoke test with only KW cabled: +20 % (LA) / +7 % (TS).
- Control (couplings off or LS on channel 1): hop-count 2500 Mb/s; DPIR keeps the direct spans.
- Live ramp: DPIR keeps the direct spans up to INR 10 dB and moves F2 from 12 dB.
- Encore (INR 14 dB): fading LE to SNR 5 dB makes DPIR put F2 back on the direct span.
- IP-50 side-hop option: 56 MHz: DPIR 2138 vs hop-count 970 Mb/s, 112 MHz: DPIR 2500 vs hop-count 970 Mb/s.

Run A, idle links silent (F1 bursts, F2 constant):

| Hop-count | 55.0 % | 60 s | 0 |

| Reactive capacity-aware (idle links report what they see) | 83.8 % | 0 s | 4 |
| Reactive capacity-aware (idle links report clean rate) | 69.4 % | 30 s | 64 |
| DPIR without predictor (one step late) | 98.5 % | 2 s | 4 |
| DPIR with predictor | 100.0 % | 0 s | 4 |

Run B, worst case: QoS-Null floor, F1/F2 anti-phase, 5 s re-ignition:

| Router | Delivered | Ignitions |
|---|---|---|
| Hop-count | 35.5 % | 0 |
| DPIR, routing only | 35.5 % | 0 |

4-flow extension (16 joint routings): DPIR 3878 vs hop-count 1940 Mb/s.

## Bench run

1. **Rack and sync.** Rack GTS003 #1 (U16: W1, E2, all sectors even) and #2 (U13: E1, W2, all odd). Get GNSS/PPS lock on both. Bring up the E2E controller (it stays up). Per radio: channel 2, polarity, Golay LN 1 / LE 1 / LS 2 / LW 2, TPC off with fixed TX power, LA on (MCS 2-12), PBF/IM/RTCAL scans off.
2. **Port check.** Before any coupling: on one SMA port per module check DC, LO (7-8.2 GHz) and control tones; measure IF TX level and RX range. Decide pads, DC blocks and filters from this.
3. **Idle-emission test (go/no-go).** Gated / zero-span power on a coupler's coupled port with the aggressor at 0, 10, 50, 100 % iperf duty. Idle floor below ~0.5 % of the data airtime: routing alone switches the coupling (plan A). Floor near 4 % (QoS-Null every slot): DPIR must also take the unused span down (plan B); time a re-ignition.
4. **Links.** Cable LN, LE, LS, LW through ATT-1..4 (tile i to tile i), coupling arms through ATT-5/6 at 63 dB (off). Find each link's drop point, then set LN and LS to SNR ~25 dB (MCS12) and LE, LW to ~12 dB (MCS9). Confirm 4-tile operation (txRficBitmap). VNA: every uncoupled path >= span loss + SNR + 10 dB.
5. **Calibrate the couplings.** As terragraph-ctf PUMA_RF_LA-5.0: load the aggressor span (1600 Mb/s UDP), put 900 Mb/s on the victim, step ATT-5 then ATT-6 in 2 dB steps from off to SIR 3 dB; log victim MCS, PER, throughput and aggressor duty; repeat at aggressor duty 0-100 %. Set the nominal SIR 7 dB (INR ~18 dB).
6. **Static A/B.** 5 min per arm, UDP F1 W1->E1 1600 Mb/s and F2 E2->W2 900 Mb/s: (1) hop-count (Open/R metrics fixed at 1), (2) Open/R MCS-based metrics (Terragraph default), (3) DPIR (soft-drain LS, or site-router policy route E2->E1->W1->W2). Log per-flow throughput, loss, delay; per-link MCS, SNR, PER, TX duty.
7. **Controls.** Couplings off, then LS moved to channel 1: hop-count must recover to 2500 Mb/s.
8. **Live ramp.** Step ATT-5/ATT-6 by 2 dB per routing period from off to the nominal setting: DPIR keeps the direct spans to INR ~10 dB and moves F2 at ~12 dB; a router one period late loses that period.
9. **Encore.** At INR ~14 dB fade LE (ATT-2) from SNR 12 to 5 dB: DPIR brings F2 back to the direct span once the detour is worth less than the interference it avoids.
10. **Dynamic run.** F1 on/off (30 s on / 30 s off, then irregular), F2 constant, 1 s routing step: predictive DPIR, DPIR without its predictor, Open/R MCS routing, hop-count. Report delivered traffic, F2 dips at burst onset, route changes, delay. Plan B adds link activation with the measured ignition time.
11. **Optional.** 4-flow extension (F3 E1->W1, F4 W2->E2: 16 joint routings) and scheduled fades on ATT-2/ATT-4; the IP-50 side-hop variant if microwave continuity with PoC 1 is wanted.

## Open questions for the lab

- **FATJ0498 SMA ports.** IF only, or also DC, LO or control? IF TX level and RX range? Can a link run single-tile on the reference tile (4 couplers instead of 16)?
- **Idle emission.** Do idle sectors on the Siklu firmware leave their TX slots empty or send QoS-Null? This decides plan A (routing) or plan B (routing + link activation).
- **Control surface.** Does Siklu expose per-radio polarity, channel, Golay, TPC/TX power, scan disable and Open/R softDisable / fixedMetric / linkMetricConfig to an external controller? How fast does a route change apply?
- **Timing.** How is GNSS/PPS fed to the GTS003 boxes (internal antenna, external connector, common PPS)? How long does a link take to re-ignite?
- **Spider box layout.** Which modules belong to node a and node b (assumed M1-M2 = a, M3-M4 = b)? Isolation inside a box and between boxes at 13-18 GHz?
- **Attenuators.** Do PoC 1's 4-channel IF attenuators match ZTDAT-4-18G63S (insertion loss, channel isolation at 13-17.4 GHz)? ZUDC10-183+ directivity there?
- **Scenario.** Is a single-channel plan with deliberately cabled heuristic-4 couplings acceptable as PoC 2's interference scenario? (In this layout the coupled sectors do not face each other: the coupling is emulated and its strength is whatever the bench sets.)
- **DPIR paper.** Full text not read (ideals.illinois.edu and arxiv.org blocked here). Confirm its interference model (SINR between active links?), action (a path per flow per step?), inputs, baselines and sizes; and whether 2-4 flows on 4 nodes are enough to train and evaluate it.

## Model notes

- Rates: Terragraph QTI 10.11 LA thresholds and CTF per-direction rates (Meta open source). Siklu's values may differ: calibrate on the bench before quoting gains.
- Each sector is its own radio and each direction has its own subframe, so a relay costs no airtime and opposite directions share no capacity. Flows sharing a direction split it max-min fair.
- The coupling is emulated: in this layout the coupled sectors do not face each other, so it stands for Terragraph's heuristic-4 interference or a reflection; its strength is set by ATT-5/6.
- 'DPIR' here is the best joint routing under this model, i.e. what DPIR should find. Whether the GNN/DRL agent finds it from telemetry, and how early its predictor sees a burst, is what the bench measures. With 2 flows x 2 routes an exhaustive search also finds it; the bench shows the value of interference-awareness and prediction, not DPIR's edge over an exhaustive optimiser.
